falsification_conditions.condition: The S&P 500 Index closes above its 200-day moving average by at least 5% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A clear bullish breakout would contradict the 'HOLD' signal and indicate a trend reversal invalidating the current unknown verdict

falsification_conditions.condition: The 14-day average trading volume on the Nasdaq Composite exceeds 200% of its 30-day moving average on any single day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained extreme volume would indicate a market blowoff or breakout, directly contradicting the current 'HOLD' signal

falsification_conditions.condition: The CBOE VIX Index drops below 12 for three consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained period of extreme low volatility would invalidate the current 'HOLD' signal by indicating a market complacency that contradicts the blowoff score and pattern match

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
